description: Apply a Photoshop filter (op=apply, the default) to a DUPLICATE of the active layer by default — the original is preserved, undo by deleting the copy. Pass apply_to_active_layer:true to bake into the original instead. Choose the filter with `type` (see the `type` field for its params); pass as_smart_filter:true on a Smart Object to apply it as a re-editable SMART FILTER instead of rasterizing. This same tool also reads and manages that re-editable Smart Filter stack: op=list (every filter's index/name/type/enabled/opacity/blend), op=set_visibility (toggle one off/on), op=set_blend (restyle opacity/blend_mode), op=remove (delete one). Management ops need a 1-based `index` from op=list first — index 1 is the first-applied filter, at the bottom of the stack. Covers blur, sharpen, noise, high_pass, pixelate, distort, displace, and oil_paint.

amount.description: Filter strength. Range depends on type — sharpen 1–500, noise 0.1–400, radial_blur 1–100, distort/ripple −999–999.

amplitude_min.description: wave only: minimum amplitude (1-998; must be <= amplitude_max).

angle.description: Angle in degrees. Used by motion_blur (−360–360) and distort/twirl (−999–999).

angle_1.description: color_halftone only: screen angle for channel 1 in degrees. PS default 108.

angle_2.description: color_halftone only: screen angle for channel 2. PS default 162.

angle_3.description: color_halftone only: screen angle for channel 3. PS default 90.

angle_4.description: color_halftone only: screen angle for channel 4. PS default 45.

apply_to_active_layer.description: If false (default), the filter is applied to a duplicate of the active layer named "<OpName> (<Original Name>)" — the original is preserved and the LLM can undo simply by deleting the copy. If true, the filter bakes directly into the active layer (the historical destructive behavior).

as_smart_filter.description: If true, apply the filter as a re-editable SMART FILTER riding the Smart Object instead of baking it into pixels — nothing is rasterized, and the filter can later be toggled, re-blended or removed instead of being permanent. Requires the target to be a Smart Object (convert first with ps_convert_to_smart_object); errors rather than converting silently. If false (default), the filter is baked and a smart-object layer is rasterized first.

blend_mode.description: set_blend only: how the filter result composites against the unfiltered layer. Same names as ps_set_layer. Omit to leave the current mode untouched.

blue_strength.description: Per-channel: blue channel noise-reduction strength. Usually the noisiest channel in low-light photos.

cell_size.description: Cell size in pixels — used by mosaic (2-300, PS default 10), crystallize (3-300), and pointillize (3-300, PS default 5). Ignored by color_halftone/facet/fragment.

center_placement.description: Grounded alternative to center_x/center_y: NAME the blur center (a `placement` resolving to a POINT — an object centroid, an extremum, a grid intersection). The resolved document-pixel point is normalized to the 0-1 center for you and WINS over center_x/center_y. The blur runs ONLY if the objective gate PASSES.

anchors.description: Named anchors, same vocabulary as the placement-resolver tool, when this build has one (face/object/grid/extremum/corner/edge/landmark).

max_dimension.description: Long-edge px of the export the CV runs on (default 1024).

relation.description: The relation, same vocabulary as the placement-resolver tool, when this build has one.

center_x.description: Horizontal blur center, normalized 0-1 (0.5 = middle). Resolution-independent.

center_y.description: Vertical blur center, normalized 0-1 (0.5 = middle). Resolution-independent.

color_noise.description: Color (chroma) noise reduction (0-100). PS default 45. Hits the colorful speckle noise typical of high-ISO photos.

conversion.description: polar only: rect_to_polar wraps the image into a circle; polar_to_rect unwraps it.

depth_source.description: Depth map source for selective focus. "none" = uniform blur across the whole layer. "transparency" = use the layer alpha channel as depth (foreground sharper). "layerMask" = use the layer mask. PS default none.

displacement_map.description: How the map fits the layer: stretch_to_fit (resize the map) or tile (repeat it).

edge.description: trace_contour only: trace the lower or upper edge of the level. PS default lower.

enabled.description: set_visibility only: true shows the filter, false hides it. The filter stays in the stack either way and keeps all its settings.

fiber_strength.description: fibers only: fiber strength / definition (1-64). PS default 4.

focal_distance.description: Focal-plane depth value (0-255), only meaningful when depth_source != none. Pixels at this depth stay sharp; pixels farther from it blur progressively.

generators.description: wave only: number of wave generators (1-999).

height.description: emboss only: relief height in pixels (1-100). PS default 3.

highlight_fade.description: Highlights tab: amount of sharpening to fade in highlight regions (0-100). PS default 0.

highlight_radius.description: Highlights tab: local-contrast radius in pixels (1-100). PS default 30.

highlight_tonal_width.description: Highlights tab: tonal width (0-100). PS default 50.

horizontal.description: offset only: horizontal shift in pixels (positive = right).

horizontal_scale.description: Horizontal displacement scale (-999 to 999). PS default 10.

index.description: 1-based index of the filter to act on, as reported by op=list. 1 is the FIRST-APPLIED filter (bottom of the Smart Filters stack in the Layers panel). Required for every op except 'list'.

invert_depth.description: Invert the depth map. PS default false.

iris_blade_curvature.description: Iris blade curvature (0-100). 0 = polygonal bokeh, 100 = perfectly circular. PS default 0.

iris_rotation.description: Iris rotation in degrees (0-360). Rotates the iris-shape pattern. PS default 0.

iris_shape.description: Aperture iris shape — affects the look of out-of-focus highlights (bokeh). PS default hexagon. Triangle = 3 blades, octagon = 8 blades. Real lenses with fewer blades produce more polygonal bokeh.

level.description: trace_contour only: brightness level the contour traces (0-255). PS default 128.

lighting_on.description: Whether the lighting/shine relief is applied.

map_path.description: Absolute path to the displacement-map .psd file (required). The map's brightness drives the per-pixel warp — mid-gray = no shift, lighter/darker push in opposite directions.

max_radius.description: color_halftone only: maximum dot radius in pixels (4-127). PS default 8.

method.description: spin = rotational blur around the center (turntable motion); zoom = radial streaks toward/from the center (the classic "god rays" / speed-zoom look).

mode.description: surface_blur = blur while preserving edges above a threshold (skin-smoothing; radius + threshold); box_blur = fast square-kernel blur (radius); average = fill the layer with its single average color (parameterless).

motion_angle.description: Motion blur angle in degrees (-360 to 360). Only meaningful when remove_mode=motionBlur.

noise_amount.description: Noise added to the blurred result (0-100). PS default 0. Lens Blur can produce un-naturally clean blur regions; a small noise amount (5-15) keeps the texture believable.

noise_distribution.description: Noise distribution type. PS default uniform.

noise_reduction.description: Noise reduction during sharpening (0-100). PS default 10. Prevents sharpening from amplifying existing noise. For low-light photos, raise this (25-50).

number.description: tiles only: number of tiles across (1-99). PS default 10.

offset.description: tiles only: maximum tile offset percent (1-99). PS default 10.

op.description: apply (default): apply a NEW filter — set `type` (+ its own params). list: read every re-editable Smart Filter on the active Smart Object (index, name, type, enabled, opacity, blend mode). set_visibility: turn one Smart Filter on/off without losing its settings (needs `index` + `enabled`). set_blend: restyle one Smart Filter's `opacity` and/or `blend_mode` (needs `index` + at least one of them). remove: delete one Smart Filter from the stack (needs `index`). The four management ops act on the Smart Filter stack that apply as_smart_filter=true creates; indices are 1-based and come from op=list, where 1 is the first-applied filter (bottom of the stack).

opacity.description: set_blend only: filter opacity 0-100. Omit to leave the current opacity untouched.

per_channel.description: Enable per-channel advanced mode. If true, the per-channel strength/preserve_details params (red_*, green_*, blue_*) override the global strength/preserve_details for each RGB channel — useful when noise is concentrated in one channel (typically blue for low-light shots). PS default false.

preserve.description: maximum/minimum only: edge-preservation shape. PS default roundness.

preserve_details.description: Preserve details percentage (0-100). PS default 50. Higher protects edges; lower lets the smoother kick in further.

quality.description: Render quality. best is smoothest but slowest.

radius.description: Radius/distance in px. Range depends on type — gaussian_blur 0.1–250, motion_blur 1–999, lens_blur 0–100, smart_sharpen 0.1–64, high_pass 0.1–1000.

random_seed.description: wave only: random seed for the wave pattern (change for a different pattern).

red_preserve_details.description: Per-channel: red channel preserve-details percentage (0-100). Only used when per_channel=true.

red_strength.description: Per-channel: red channel noise-reduction strength (0-10). Only used when per_channel=true.

remove_jpeg_artifact.description: Remove JPEG compression artifacts (the 8x8 block boundaries and ringing). PS default false.

remove_mode.description: Blur model to remove. gaussianBlur (default) is the general-purpose modern Unsharp Mask replacement. lensBlur removes lens-style softness with better edge handling. motionBlur removes directional motion blur — pair with motion_angle.

ridges.description: zigzag only: number of concentric ridges (0-20). PS default 5.

seed.description: fibers only: randomize seed — change for a different fiber pattern. PS default 12345.

shadow_fade.description: Shadows tab: amount of sharpening to fade in shadow regions (0-100). 0 = sharpen shadows fully, 100 = no shadow sharpening. Useful for preventing shadow-noise amplification. PS default 0.

shadow_radius.description: Shadows tab: local-contrast radius in pixels (1-100). PS default 30. Defines the neighborhood used to classify pixels as shadows.

shadow_tonal_width.description: Shadows tab: tonal width — how broadly "shadows" is defined (0-100). PS default 50.

sharpen_details.description: Sharpening to apply after noise reduction (0-100). PS default 25. Compensates for the softening that noise reduction causes.

specular_brightness.description: Specular highlight brightness boost (0-255). PS default 0. Lift highlights to enhance bokeh "balls" — values around 50-100 produce visible specular highlights, higher = more dramatic.

specular_threshold.description: Specular highlight threshold (0-255). PS default 255 (no specular boost applies). Lower the threshold to let more pixels be treated as specular highlights for the brightness boost. Typical photographic use: 240-250.

strength.description: Luminance noise reduction strength (0-10). PS default 5. Higher = more aggressive noise reduction but more detail loss.

threshold.description: surface_blur only: tonal threshold (0-255) — edges differing by more than this are preserved. PS default 20.

type.description: Which filter to apply. Required when op=apply (the default); ignored otherwise. Each type uses its own parameters: gaussian_blur(radius); motion_blur(angle, radius); lens_blur(radius, iris_shape, …); radial_blur(amount, method spin|zoom, quality, center_x, center_y); sharpen=Unsharp Mask(amount, radius, threshold); smart_sharpen(amount, radius, remove_mode, …); noise=Add Noise(amount, distribution, monochromatic); reduce_noise(strength, preserve_details, color_noise, …); high_pass(radius); pixelate(mode color_halftone|mosaic|crystallize|pointillize|facet|fragment, …); distort(mode twirl|ripple|polar|wave|pinch|spherize|zigzag, …); stylize(mode emboss|find_edges|solarize|wind|trace_contour|tiles, …); render(mode clouds|difference_clouds|fibers, …); other(mode maximum|minimum|offset, …); denoise(mode median|dust_and_scratches|despeckle, …); blur(mode surface_blur|box_blur|average, …); displace(map_path, horizontal_scale, vertical_scale, …); oil_paint(stylization, cleanliness, …).

undefined_areas.description: How to fill areas pushed outside the layer.

variance.description: fibers only: color variance / streak length (1-64). PS default 16.

vertical.description: offset only: vertical shift in pixels (positive = down).

vertical_scale.description: Vertical displacement scale (-999 to 999). PS default 10.

wavelength_min.description: wave only: minimum wavelength (1-998; must be <= wavelength_max).

wind_direction.description: wind only: streak direction. PS default left.

wind_method.description: wind only: streak intensity/style. PS default wind.

name: ps_filter
